description: This file defines the 'Gateway' class responsible for managing client connections, message routing, and maintenance tasks within the Orleans runtime messaging system. It includes connection handling, message queuing, routing logic, and internal caches for client reply routing.

classes.name: Gateway
classes.description: Manages client connections, message routing, and maintenance within Orleans runtime.

classes.name: ClientState
classes.description: Represents the state of a connected client, including connection management and message queuing.

classes.name: ClientsReplyRoutingCache
classes.description: Caches reply routes to clients based on their connected gateways, with expiration logic.

methods.name: GetClientActivationAddress
methods.description: Generates a deterministic activation address for a client based on its ID and silo address.

methods.name: PerformGatewayMaintenance
methods.description: Periodically drops disconnected clients and expired cache entries.

methods.name: SendStopSendMessages
methods.description: Instructs all connected clients to stop sending messages.

methods.name: StopAsync
methods.description: Stops the gateway's maintenance timer and task.

methods.name: TryToReroute
methods.description: Determines the appropriate route for a message, considering system targets and reply routing cache.

methods.name: DropExpiredRoutingCachedEntries
methods.description: Removes expired reply routes from the cache.

methods.name: IsTargetingLocalGateway
methods.description: Checks if a given silo address matches the local gateway address.

methods.name: DropDisconnectedClients
methods.description: Drops clients that have been disconnected long enough to be considered inactive.

methods.name: TryDeliverToProxy
methods.description: Attempts to deliver a message to a client proxy if applicable.
